name: table
title: Table
description: A styled HTML table component with header, body, row dividers, and cell sub-components. Uses namespace exports: Table.Root, Table.Header, Table.Body, Table.Head, Table.Row, Table.RowDivider, Table.Cell, Table.Caption.

docs.lead: A styled HTML table component with header, body, row dividers, and cell sub-components. Works well with @tanstack/react-table for sorting, selection, and pagination.

examples.title: Data Table
examples.description: A full data table example with sortable columns, avatars, and action buttons using @tanstack/react-table.

api.name: Table.Root
api.description: The main table wrapper with horizontal scroll overflow.

api.name: Table.Head
api.description: A table header cell with subtle background and rounded corners.

api.name: Table.Body
api.description: The table body section with configurable spacing from the header.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Space in pixels between the header and body

api.name: Table.Row
api.description: A table row with group hover support.

api.name: Table.RowDivider
api.description: A visual divider row between table rows using the Divider component.

props.name: dividerClassName
props.description: Additional class name for the inner Divider component

api.name: Table.Cell
api.description: A table data cell with hover background transition.
